meta.design: macro categories with comprehensive Brightspeed billing leaves
meta.version: 2.1 comprehensive leaf taxonomy with canonical tags

subcategories.name: General billing question
subcategories.definition: General help understanding billing when no more specific issue is stated

subcategories.name: Current account balance
subcategories.definition: Customer wants the current amount owed on the account

subcategories.name: Payment due date
subcategories.definition: Customer wants to know when payment is due

subcategories.name: Bill amount or line item explanation
subcategories.definition: Customer wants an explanation of an amount, line item, or calculation without clearly alleging an error

subcategories.name: First bill explanation
subcategories.definition: Customer needs help understanding the first bill after new service or activation

subcategories.name: Prorated bill explanation
subcategories.definition: Customer asks about partial month, prorated, or midcycle billing

subcategories.name: Billing cycle or statement date
subcategories.definition: Customer asks when the billing period starts, ends, or when the statement generates

subcategories.name: Upcoming or estimated bill amount
subcategories.definition: Customer asks what a future or next bill is expected to be

subcategories.name: Bill higher than expected
subcategories.definition: Customer reports a higher total bill but has not isolated one specific erroneous charge

subcategories.name: Price or rate increase
subcategories.definition: Customer asks about an increase in recurring service price or plan rate

subcategories.name: Promotional rate expired
subcategories.definition: Customer says a promotional or introductory rate ended and the bill increased

subcategories.name: Missing or incorrect discount
subcategories.definition: Customer expects a recurring discount that is absent or wrong

subcategories.name: Lower price or discount request
subcategories.definition: Customer wants a lower monthly price, discount, or more affordable plan

subcategories.name: Plan or package price inquiry
subcategories.definition: Customer asks what a plan, package, or service tier costs

subcategories.name: Recurring charge inquiry
subcategories.definition: Customer asks about a recurring monthly charge without clearly disputing it

subcategories.name: Add on or feature recurring charge
subcategories.definition: Customer asks about a recurring charge for an added feature, service, or optional product

subcategories.name: Incorrect or unexpected charge
subcategories.definition: Customer states that a billed charge is wrong or should not be present

subcategories.name: Duplicate charge
subcategories.definition: Customer says the same charge appears more than once

subcategories.name: Unauthorized billing charge
subcategories.definition: Customer says a charge was not authorized or was not requested

subcategories.name: Billing after cancellation or disconnect
subcategories.definition: Customer disputes charges continuing after cancellation, disconnect, closure, or removal

subcategories.name: Late fee dispute
subcategories.definition: Customer says a late fee was assessed incorrectly

subcategories.name: Late fee waiver or avoidance
subcategories.definition: Customer asks to waive, remove, or avoid a plausible late fee

subcategories.name: Returned payment or insufficient funds fee
subcategories.definition: Customer asks about a fee caused by a returned or insufficient funds payment

subcategories.name: Reconnection or restoration fee
subcategories.definition: Customer asks about a fee charged to reconnect or restore service

subcategories.name: Tax or regulatory fee inquiry
subcategories.definition: Customer asks about taxes, government fees, or regulatory charges

subcategories.name: Tax recovery surcharge
subcategories.definition: Customer specifically asks about or disputes the tax recovery surcharge

subcategories.name: Incorrect tax or fee amount
subcategories.definition: Customer believes a tax, surcharge, or mandatory fee amount is wrong

subcategories.name: Make a one time payment
subcategories.definition: Customer wants to make a single payment outside AutoPay

subcategories.name: General payment question
subcategories.definition: Customer has a payment question without a more specific payment issue

subcategories.name: Online or app payment issue
subcategories.definition: Customer cannot complete a payment through the website, portal, or app

subcategories.name: Payment declined or failed
subcategories.definition: A non AutoPay payment attempt was declined or failed

subcategories.name: Payment not posted
subcategories.definition: Customer says a completed payment is missing from the account or balance

subcategories.name: Payment applied to wrong account
subcategories.definition: Customer says a completed payment was credited to the wrong account

subcategories.name: Payment confirmation or receipt
subcategories.definition: Customer wants confirmation that a payment was received or a receipt or confirmation number

subcategories.name: Payment reversed or returned
subcategories.definition: Customer asks why a previously completed payment was reversed, returned, or removed

subcategories.name: Duplicate payment
subcategories.definition: Customer reports that the same payment was made or withdrawn more than once

subcategories.name: Partial payment
subcategories.definition: Customer asks whether or how to make a payment for less than the total amount due

subcategories.name: Check or mailed payment status
subcategories.definition: Customer asks about a check, money order, or mailed payment that is pending or missing

subcategories.name: Payment history or transaction details
subcategories.definition: Customer wants details about prior payments, dates, amounts, or methods

subcategories.name: AutoPay general inquiry
subcategories.definition: Customer asks a general question about automatic payments

subcategories.name: Enroll in AutoPay
subcategories.definition: Customer wants to start automatic payments

subcategories.name: Confirm AutoPay enrollment
subcategories.definition: Customer wants to verify whether AutoPay is active

subcategories.name: Remove AutoPay
subcategories.definition: Customer wants to stop or disable automatic payments

subcategories.name: AutoPay payment failure
subcategories.definition: An expected automatic payment did not process

subcategories.name: AutoPay charged wrong amount
subcategories.definition: Customer says AutoPay withdrew an incorrect amount

subcategories.name: Duplicate AutoPay withdrawal
subcategories.definition: Customer says AutoPay withdrew more than once for the same bill

subcategories.name: Change AutoPay payment date
subcategories.definition: Customer wants to change when an automatic payment is withdrawn

subcategories.name: Update or replace payment method
subcategories.definition: Customer wants to add, change, or replace a card or bank account

subcategories.name: Update AutoPay payment method
subcategories.definition: Customer specifically wants to change the card or bank account used for AutoPay

subcategories.name: Compromised card or bank account
subcategories.definition: Customer needs to replace a payment method because it is compromised or closed

categories.name: Payment Assistance Past Due and Collections

subcategories.name: Payment arrangement general inquiry
subcategories.definition: Customer asks about payment plans or arrangements

subcategories.name: Set up payment arrangement
subcategories.definition: Customer wants to establish a payment arrangement

subcategories.name: Extend due date or request more time
subcategories.definition: Customer asks for additional time to pay or a due date extension

subcategories.name: Payment arrangement system or eligibility issue
subcategories.definition: Customer cannot create or manage an arrangement because of a system or eligibility problem

subcategories.name: Missed or broken payment arrangement
subcategories.definition: Customer has missed a promised payment or an existing arrangement is no longer valid

subcategories.name: Financial hardship or payment assistance
subcategories.definition: Customer requests hardship support or billing assistance because they cannot afford the bill

subcategories.name: Past due balance or nonpayment
subcategories.definition: Customer is calling about an overdue or delinquent balance

subcategories.name: Service suspended or disconnected for nonpayment
subcategories.definition: Customer reports service suspension or disconnect caused by unpaid billing

subcategories.name: Restore service after payment
subcategories.definition: Customer has paid or plans to pay and wants service restored

subcategories.name: Collections notice or agency inquiry
subcategories.definition: Customer asks about debt collection activity or a collection agency

subcategories.name: Credit reporting or credit score concern
subcategories.definition: Customer is concerned that billing or collections affected credit reporting

subcategories.name: Paid debt still in collections
subcategories.definition: Customer says a debt was paid but collections or credit reporting still shows it outstanding

subcategories.name: General credit request
subcategories.definition: Customer asks for a bill or account credit without a more specific reason

subcategories.name: General refund request
subcategories.definition: Customer asks for money to be returned without a more specific refund issue

subcategories.name: Outage credit or bill adjustment
subcategories.definition: Customer requests a credit because service was unavailable or impaired

subcategories.name: Service quality credit
subcategories.definition: Customer requests a credit for poor, slow, or unreliable service rather than a total outage

subcategories.name: Missing credit or adjustment
subcategories.definition: Customer was promised or expects a credit that is not reflected on the account

subcategories.name: Refund not received or refund status
subcategories.definition: Customer expects a refund and wants its status because it has not arrived or posted

subcategories.name: Refund method or timing inquiry
subcategories.definition: Customer asks how or when a refund will be issued

subcategories.name: Overpayment refund
subcategories.definition: Customer wants a refund of money paid above the amount owed

subcategories.name: Deposit refund
subcategories.definition: Customer asks about return of a security or service deposit

subcategories.name: Bill copy or statement request
subcategories.definition: Customer needs a copy of a bill or statement

subcategories.name: Bill not received
subcategories.definition: Customer says an expected bill or statement was not received

subcategories.name: Paperless billing general inquiry
subcategories.definition: Customer asks about electronic or paperless billing

subcategories.name: Enroll in paperless billing
subcategories.definition: Customer wants to stop paper statements and receive bills electronically

subcategories.name: Switch to paper billing
subcategories.definition: Customer wants printed statements instead of paperless billing

subcategories.name: Billing email or notification issue
subcategories.definition: Customer is not receiving billing emails or payment notifications

subcategories.name: Online account access or verification
subcategories.definition: Customer cannot access or verify the online account needed for billing

subcategories.name: Update billing address
subcategories.definition: Customer wants to change the billing or mailing address

subcategories.name: Update billing contact information
subcategories.definition: Customer wants to change billing email, phone, or contact information

subcategories.name: General reward inquiry
subcategories.definition: Customer asks a general question about a reward or incentive

subcategories.name: Promotional gift card not received
subcategories.definition: Customer was promised a promotional gift card but has not received it

subcategories.name: Promotional gift card status
subcategories.definition: Customer asks for the status of a promotional gift card

subcategories.name: Gift card amount or value inquiry
subcategories.definition: Customer asks how much a reward or promotional gift card should be worth

subcategories.name: Promotion or reward eligibility
subcategories.definition: Customer asks whether they qualify for a billing promotion, reward, or incentive

subcategories.name: Promotion terms or fulfillment timing
subcategories.definition: Customer asks about requirements or timing for receiving a promotion or reward

categories.name: Service Changes Equipment and Final Billing

subcategories.name: Final bill after cancellation
subcategories.definition: Customer asks about an expected closing or final bill after service ends

subcategories.name: Cancel or disconnect service with billing impact
subcategories.definition: Customer wants to cancel or disconnect and is asking about charges, balance, or final billing

subcategories.name: Remove service or charge
subcategories.definition: Customer wants a billed service, feature, or associated recurring charge removed

subcategories.name: Vacation hold billing
subcategories.definition: Customer asks what they will be charged during a temporary vacation or seasonal service hold, or disputes billing during that hold

subcategories.name: Resume service after vacation hold billing
subcategories.definition: Customer asks about billing when resuming service after a temporary hold

subcategories.name: Move or transfer service billing
subcategories.definition: Customer asks how moving service to another address affects billing, credits, deposits, or final and first bills

subcategories.name: Upgrade or downgrade billing impact
subcategories.definition: Customer asks how changing speed, technology, or plan affects the bill

subcategories.name: Add service or feature billing impact
subcategories.definition: Customer asks what adding another service or feature will do to the bill

subcategories.name: Change effective date or proration
subcategories.definition: Customer asks how the effective date of a service change affects prorated charges

subcategories.name: Closed account balance or final payment
subcategories.definition: Customer asks what remains owed or refundable after the account is closed

subcategories.name: Modem or router rental fee
subcategories.definition: Customer asks about recurring rental charges for a modem, router, gateway, or similar equipment

subcategories.name: Equipment purchase or ownership charge
subcategories.definition: Customer asks about buying equipment, ownership, or a one time equipment charge

subcategories.name: Equipment return or nonreturn charge
subcategories.definition: Customer asks about a charge related to returning or failing to return equipment

subcategories.name: Installation or activation charge
subcategories.definition: Customer asks about installation, activation, or setup charges

subcategories.name: Technician visit or service call charge
subcategories.definition: Customer asks about a billed technician visit or service call fee

subcategories.name: Equipment shipping or handling charge
subcategories.definition: Customer asks about shipping or handling fees for equipment

subcategories.name: Replacement equipment charge
subcategories.definition: Customer asks about a charge for replacement equipment

subcategories.name: Misc or Other billing
subcategories.definition: The call is billing related but no defined subcategory fits adequately
